name: Lizhong Sitong Light Alloys Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Lizhong Sitong Light Alloys Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, manufacture, and sale of functional master alloys, recycled cast aluminum alloy materials, and aluminum alloy wheel products. It operates through three segments: Aluminum-Based Functional Master Alloys, Recycled Cast Aluminum Alloys, And Aluminum Alloy Wheels.
